description: For a total recursive index sequence \(i\mapsto e_i\), there is a partial recursive unary function defined at \(x\) exactly when \(\varphi_{e_i}(x)\) is defined for at least one \(i\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.UniversalComputation.countable_dovetail {e : ℕ → ℕ} (he : Computable e) :
  ∃ h, Nat.Partrec h ∧ ∀ (x : ℕ), (h x).Dom ↔ ∃ i, (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.UniversalComputation.phi (e i) x).Dom
